lines.en: I shift among the vines.

lines.zh: 根须随着我的身体拖动。
lines.en: Roots drag along with my body.

lines.zh: 这片地被我压出一道沟。
lines.en: I press a trench into the ground.
Petals fall behind me.
The vines part for me.
I push between the tree roots.
Things in the soil have woken.
My flower crown sways near the ground.

lines.zh: 我慢慢朝你那边压过来。
lines.en: I bear down slowly toward you.

lines.zh: 每一步都带着根须的响动。
lines.en: Every step drags roots along.

lines.zh: 我停在原地，花瓣一张一合。
lines.en: I stop still, petals opening and closing.
Roots stretch slowly in the soil.

lines.zh: 这里的地面早就听我的。
lines.en: The ground here answers to me.
My crown turns to the light.
Vines coil quietly around the trees.

lines.zh: 我不动的时候，林子也不动。
lines.en: When I am still, the grove is still.
A layer of pollen falls on the grass.
My roots turn over beneath the soil.

lines.zh: 土里有东西在我脚下动。
lines.en: Something moves in the soil beneath me.
My petals are thick enough to turn a blade.
This is my garden.
Light comes through petals eight blocks wide.
Wind through the vine wall sounds soft.
I wait for you to come closer.
I know every inch of this ground.
My roots reach very far.
You've stepped into my garden.
These vines are all mine.
I counted every blade of grass you snapped.

lines.zh: 我听得见每一根草断掉。
lines.en: I hear every blade of grass break.

lines.zh: 你手上那截木头是什么？
lines.en: What is that billet of wood in your hand?
I've been watching a good while.
You're standing in front of a flower.
It is part of me.
Move away from the flowers.
This garden doesn't know you.
This garden doesn't welcome blades.
I slowly turn my crown toward you.
You cut into my crown.
The stem swayed once.
A petal fell.
That was no light blow.
My roots flinched.
The garden is counting for you.
You're hurting the ground under your feet.
I slowly raise my crown again.
The garden will mend this.
How many swings do you have left?
Don't put your filth on my soil.
A flower eight blocks wide does not eat that.
I am the garden, not the gardener.
That smell bothers me.

lines.zh: 我的藤蔓一展，八格都占了。
lines.en: One spread of my vines fills eight blocks.
I need only earth and water.
This soil has no need of your gifts.
My roots don't need it.

lines.zh: 你再举着，我就当你要动手。
lines.en: Keep holding it and I'll take it as a challenge.
Put it down and back away slowly.
You hit my vines.
They didn't budge.
You're the one who rebounded.
Don't touch my stems.
I slowly shift my body away.

lines.zh: 我们撞在一起，草都被压平。
lines.en: We collided and the grass flattened.
You backed to the steps.
This is the garden's heart.

lines.zh: 你撞上花茎，粉落了满头。
lines.en: You hit my stalk and get covered in pollen.
You'll struggle to keep your footing.
I'm the only one in this garden.
I don't need such things.
I have the whole grove for company.
I am a garden, not a living thing.

lines.zh: 花开的时候我自己就够。
lines.en: When the flowers bloom, I am enough.
You had best leave now.
The vines are closing in.
Don't come closer.
My whole wall of vines is enough.
I sink slowly back into the soil.

lines.zh: 我把这块埋进土里，根会化开。
lines.en: I bury this; my roots will dissolve it.
It's too dry to nourish anything.
What you dropped, the garden keeps.
My roots will break it down.
Nothing will grow from this.
I push it aside.
It's covering a seedling.
I toss it beyond the vines.
These shouldn't be in the garden.
You'd better take it away.
You raise an axe, and my roots wake.

lines.zh: 花园里不许有这种东西。
lines.en: Such things aren't allowed in the garden.
Every ring of soil here belongs to my roots.
They know you now.
Roots lift from the ground.
My petals spread wide.

lines.zh: 我的藤从地下一直伸上来。
lines.en: My vines reach up from deep underground.

lines.zh: 你身后的藤已经长成墙。
lines.en: The vines behind you have grown into a wall.
The garden will close itself.
Vines close behind you.
My roots reach under your feet.
The ground you stand on is me too.
Don't think about running.
Every step here is mine.
I lift my crown slowly.
The wind stopped. The garden is very quiet.
Every root in this grove is moving.
My bloom opens; pollen falls first.
My petals are starting to burn hot.
This time, I won't let you out.
My roots follow your feet.
You go left, the vines go left.
The ground you stand on is sinking.
My vines come up from below.
Cut one, and ten more remain.
My petals stand before you.
You've backed to the stone steps.
That's the garden's edge.
A step more and you're outside.
I won't let you out.
I smell iron in your sweat.
Your blade is starting to chip.
I see you counting the vines.
They're beyond counting.
The soil by your feet is shifting.
My flower opens above your head.
The pollen is falling.
Don't breathe it in.
You already did.
Let this be your end.
My vine lashes out.
Your wrist is caught.
Petals fly at you one by one.
You block, and your hand bleeds.
My roots thrust up through the ground.
You're tripped to your knees.
I lash again, hard.
You fall back two steps, unsteady.
Your shoulder guard split open.
Clods of earth hit your back.
With that, the garden has learned you.
I coil once more.
A vine lashes across your calf.
I hurl you into a tree.
The vines part down the middle.
I rise out of the flower.
Petals fall everywhere.
This garden has finally woken.
The soil splits under me.
My roots reach into every inch.
You're standing in my garden.
It used to be quiet here.
Not quiet anymore.
I slowly open one petal.
My crown is bigger than a door.
Vine walls rise on all sides.
The way you came is closing.
The air is full of pollen.

lines.zh: 八格宽的花，把走廊堵死。
lines.en: An eight-block bloom plugs the corridor.

lines.zh: 你是第一个走到这儿的。
lines.en: You're the first to make it here.
So stay.
I lift my roots.
The garden begins to breathe.
Now, no one leaves.

lines.zh: 火烧上来，我的花瓣卷了起来。
lines.en: Fire came and my petals curled.

lines.zh: 从高处落下来，我的根先着地。
lines.en: From a height, my roots hit first.

lines.zh: 水浸透了我的根，我沉得很慢。
lines.en: Water soaked my roots and I sank slowly.

lines.zh: 爆炸把我的花瓣撕开一半。
lines.en: The blast tore half my petals.
An arrow stuck in my flower's heart.
The spell seared along my vines.

lines.zh: 没有水和土，我在慢慢枯。
lines.en: Without water and soil, I am withering.

lines.zh: 雷劈在花园里，藤上都起了火。
lines.en: Lightning struck the garden, and the vines caught fire.

lines.zh: 这里没有土，我的根抓不住。
lines.en: No soil here. My roots cannot hold.
